title: 第17章 年轻一代大比第18章 十万大山
content_zh:
大长老被带下去疗伤，而苏家众人也都散去。
这一次苏家人受到的打击实在是太大。
不少年轻一辈都是暗中攥拳，发誓好好修炼，一定要为苏家一雪前耻！
战台周围，只剩下苏震山、苏辰父子，还有寥寥几人。
苏辰转头看向苏震山，凝声问道：“爹，这天水城年轻一代大比是什么？”
苏震山叹息一声：“辰儿，之前你被带去太玄门修炼，所以不知道这件事情，我们四大家族商定，从前年开始，每一年举行一次年轻一代大比，四大家族的一些争执，都由小辈大比来解决，至于小辈的年龄限制，则是定在十八岁。”
苏辰抬了抬眉毛：“那咱们苏家的战绩如何？”
“很差！”
苏震山摇头，“之前两次大比，咱们都是第三位甚至第四位，苏青云虽然在咱们苏家小辈中不错，可比起其它三大家族最杰出的小辈就有所不如了。”
苏辰点点头。
苏家最杰出的小辈应该是自己，苏青云实际上只是第二人罢了，只是自己在太玄门中修炼，无法参加这次大比，因此苏家占一些劣势也是正常。
“那林昊实力如何？”
苏辰又问道。
“十分强劲！”
苏震山的脸上露出凝重之色，“在这之前，已经举办了两次大比，林昊第一次时是十六岁，九级武徒境界，夺得了大比第一，之后一次，他十七岁，一级武士境界，也同样是第一！”
苏辰点了点头。
这林昊差不多一年两级左右的提升，在天水城中堪称天才。
只不过……
这个速度苏辰依旧不放在眼里。
苏震山提醒道：“辰儿，这次的年轻一代大比，林昊很可能要针对你，你若是参加的话，一定要小心，你才十六岁，还可以参加两届大比，到时候天水城年轻一代就没有你的对手了。”

“这一届大比还有多少天？”
苏辰询问道。
“只剩下半月了，实际上，林昊已经进入了郡城学府，就是为了这次青年大比提前回来的。”
苏震山道。
“只有半个月了？”
苏辰一怔，旋即苦笑。
难怪最看好自己的父亲也让自己下一次再为家族争光。
苏辰现在的修炼速度的确惊人，可也无法做到在半个月时间内提升到武士境界。
“辰儿，这次你战胜了苏青云，我本想带你去好好庆祝一番，但现在情况特殊，为父要认真修炼，再度冲击大武师境界！”
苏震山双目之中露出凝重之色。
content_en:
The great elder was taken down for treatment, and everyone in the Su family dispersed.
This time the Su family was hit really hard.
Many of the younger generation secretly clenched their fists and vowed to practice hard and avenge the Su family's shame!
Around the battle platform, only Su Zhenshan, Su Chen and his son, and a few others were left.
Su Chen turned to look at Su Zhenshan and asked in a solemn voice: "Dad, what is the competition for the younger generation of Tianshui City?"
Su Zhenshan sighed: "Chen'er, you were taken to Taixuanmen to practice before, so you don't know about this matter. Our four major families have agreed to hold a competition for the younger generation every year starting from the year before last. Some disputes among the four major families will be resolved by the junior competition. As for the age limit for juniors, it is set at eighteen years old."
Su Chen raised his eyebrows: "What's the record of our Su family?"
"Very bad!"
Su Zhenshan shook his head, "In the previous two competitions, we were ranked third or even fourth. Although Su Qingyun is good among the juniors of our Su family, he is not as good as the most outstanding juniors of the other three major families."
Su Chen nodded.
The most outstanding junior of the Su family should be himself. Su Qingyun is actually only the second person. However, he is practicing in Taixuan Sect and cannot participate in this competition. Therefore, it is normal for the Su family to have some disadvantages.
"How is Lin Hao's strength?"
Su Chen asked again.
"Very strong!"
Su Zhenshan's face showed a solemn look, "Before this, two competitions have been held. The first time Lin Hao was sixteen years old and at the ninth level of martial arts apprentice, he won the first place in the competition. The next time, when he was seventeen years old and at the first level of warrior level, he also ranked first!"
Su Chen nodded.
Lin Hao's improvement of about two levels a year is considered a genius in Tianshui City.
It's just...
Su Chen still ignored this speed.
Su Zhenshan reminded: "Chen'er, Lin Hao is likely to target you in this competition for the younger generation. If you participate, you must be careful. You are only sixteen years old and can participate in two competitions. By then, the younger generation in Tianshui City will have no opponents for you."
"How many days are left until this competition?"
Su Chen asked.
"There is only half a month left. In fact, Lin Hao has already entered the county school and came back early for this youth competition."
Su Zhenshan said.
"Only half a month?"
Su Chen was startled, then smiled bitterly.
No wonder his father, who was most optimistic about him, also asked him to bring glory to the family next time.
Su Chen's current cultivation speed is indeed amazing, but he cannot achieve the level of warrior in half a month.
"Chen'er, you defeated Su Qingyun this time. I wanted to take you to celebrate, but now the situation is special. As a father, I have to practice seriously and hit the realm of a great martial artist again!"
Su Zhenshan's eyes showed a solemn look.
